topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and the Microenvironment
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes, learning outcomes, and foundational concepts regarding cancer evolution and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications confer selective advantages and alter transcriptional states during early tumor evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate the role of normal tissue hierarchies and stem cell properties in determining tumor initiation across leukemia and colorectal cancer models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Stromal Promotion of Tumor Growth
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate how inflammatory signals, external promoters, and supportive stroma are required to enable malignant outgrowth in incipient and established tumors.

topics.label: Methods for Studying Tumor Evolution and Spatial Biology
topics.groupedBecause: It details the experimental models, sequencing technologies, and spatial profiling tools used to analyse tumor cell interactions and mutational histories in the laboratory.

topics.label: Integrative Framework of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes how mutational burden, cell of origin, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental conditions converge to drive cancer progression.

topics.label: Closing Framing
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the subject of the following lecture.
